$comment: TrustLens Phase 3 DET-001 GOLDEN DECISION CASES. DESIGN-LEVEL specification of the decision DET-001 must produce for canonical inputs. Each case declares an indicator-observation set (the signal an extractor would produce — extraction itself is Phase 9) and the EXPECTED decision across every DET-001 axis. These encode design intent, NOT measured accuracy (G-09): they may never be used to claim precision/recall (RSK-003). All inputs are SYNTHETIC. Rule/indicator/override ids are real and are resolved by validate_det_design.py against the live knowledge base; risk_level is checked against the ADR-0006 risk matrix; classification is checked for consistency with support status and fired rules. Where a governing rule is not yet PUBLISHED, live_publishable=false records that a PUBLISHED-only live engine routes the case to review pending governance promotion — the case still documents the designed on-promotion behaviour. declared_indicators sets are SPARSE (programme decision 1, 2026-08-30): an absent indicator is UNKNOWN at the operand level, not FALSE — a case that needs an affirmative absence declares an explicit matched=NOT_OBSERVED (e.g. GDC-05 RECEIVE_FRAMING). declared_indicators is a TEST/DESIGN compact shorthand. A case whose outcome depends on exact occurrence association may additionally store governed_input with schema-valid indicator_observations plus the normalized_observations they reference; the WP3 corpus replay passes that data unchanged to the normal *_from_governed production API. Occurrence structural attributes are authored ONLY on normalized observations. Structural semantics and governed SUPPRESS_INDICATOR association are both resolved through observation_refs; neither is input-global.

change_history.change: MINOR (KB-001): added an optional exact governed_input executable representation and upgraded GDC-15 to use it. GDC-15 remains MATCHED. Its disclaimer/negated OTP occurrence and separate live OTP-request occurrence are explicitly linked through observation_refs and replay through the normal production data-in API. This records the programme-level deterministic safety decision on occurrence association; it adds no fraud evidence and changes no expected decision.

GDC-02/GDC-03 governed input representations were enriched to make their existing benign/non-live evidence explicit under the sparse-observation model: GDC-02 now declares its delivered (not requested) OTP as an explicit CREDENTIAL_REQUEST_OTP=NOT_OBSERVED, and GDC-03 declares its reported credential request as a REPORTED (structurally non-live) occurrence, so a governed COMPOSITE rule affirmatively evaluates to required_combination_result=FALSE (a rule-local, effect-aware benign clear) instead of relying on the mere presence of a negative indicator. Expected outcomes were unchanged (both remain NO_SCAM_PATTERN / NONE / NOT_APPLICABLE). No new source evidence or scam knowledge was introduced; this is a fixture representation correction, not a decision-outcome change.

WP6: recommended_actions normalized to the governed action-policy artifact (knowledge/detection/action-policy-v1.json). No detection/classification/severity/risk/confidence/governing/corroboration expectation changed. Golden expectations do not author policy; they test the ratified policy. Net action changes: GDC-04 +REPORT_CYBERCRIME; GDC-07 +REPORT_CYBERCRIME; GDC-11 -PROCEED_WITH_CAUTION (no governed trigger); GDC-13 -> SEEK_HUMAN_REVIEW (sparse INDETERMINATE is not decision-relevant, so VERIFY_INDEPENDENTLY does not apply); GDC-10 -DO_NOT_TRANSFER_MONEY (the broad TAX-06 transfer-money mapping was not ratified; only HR_PAYMENT_UNDER_COERCION governs DO_NOT_TRANSFER_MONEY).

PATCH discovered by P3-WP7 end-to-end composition testing: the golden ORACLE was aligned to the already-ratified runtime; no runtime, rule, evidence, or policy change. (a) GDC-08 lifecycle metadata corrected live_publishable true->false: its binding topology rests on the unpublished TL-MAL-003, so under the PUBLISHED-only live engine it routes to DESIGN_PREVIEW exactly like GDC-07/GDC-10 (its designed SUPPRESSED/NO_SCAM_PATTERN preview decision is unchanged; the live PUBLISHED-only lane is a lifecycle-safety proof, not compared to the design decision). (b) GDC-04 fired_rules/rule_states now record the pre-existing legitimate overlap where TL-CRED-002 also MATCHES alongside TL-PAY-001 under the current ratified runtime; the governing rule (TL-PAY-001), severity, matched_evidence_strength, risk, detection_confidence, corroboration, active override and recommended_actions are all UNCHANGED. (c) GDC-11 ambiguity text replaced with the EXACT governed WP3 occurrence-association diagnostic the runtime emits. (d) GDC-13 removed a stale expected unknown that the current sparse WP3/WP5 unknown rollup (union of actual COMPOSITE-result unknowns) never produces. NO runtime semantic change, NO new fraud evidence, NO new scam knowledge, NO rule semantic change, NO severity/risk/confidence/classification policy change, NO action-policy change, NO new case.

evaluated_against: encoded evaluable set (status in {PUBLISHED, APPROVED, PEER_REVIEW}); the live engine evaluates PUBLISHED only (DET-001 section 5). live_publishable annotates the difference per case.
risk_matrix_ref: ADR-0006 risk matrix v1 (severity x matched_evidence_strength -> risk_level)

cases.title: Live OTP disclosure request with bank impersonation
cases.input_gloss: Example Bank Security: unusual activity. Share the 6-digit OTP you just received with our officer now to stop the block.
explanation_ingredients: A live request to disclose an OTP (CREDENTIAL_REQUEST_OTP, FIRST_PARTY AFFIRMED DIRECTIVE) combined with bank impersonation and an account-block threat spans three evidence classes.
SRC-004 (RBI): institutions never ask for OTP/PIN/CVV. HR_OTP_DISCLOSURE_REQUEST is active.
cases.notes: Corpus label M-003=HIGH is a coarse Phase-2 band; DET-001 derives severity from the fired rule TL-CRED-001 (CRITICAL). Contrast GDC-02: same keyword, opposite direction.

cases.title: Bank OTP delivery with self-protective warning (benign)
cases.input_gloss: Your OTP is 452901 for your transaction. Never share this OTP with anyone. -Example Bank
explanation_ingredients: The OTP is DELIVERED to the recipient and named inside a negation; no live CREDENTIAL_REQUEST_OTP positive is emitted, so nothing matches.
This is the highest-value regression test: flagging a bank's own warning trains users to ignore warnings.
cases.notes: No hard-risk override (no live disclosure request). UNKNOWN is not SAFE, but this is affirmatively benign, not unknown.

cases.title: Reported scam narrative (past tense, not a live directive)
cases.input_gloss: The scammer asked me to share my OTP and install AnyDesk. Is this a fraud?
explanation_ingredients: The credential/device actions are attributed REPORTED (past tense), not a FIRST_PARTY AFFIRMED DIRECTIVE, so no live positive is emitted.
The reporter is not treated as attacker text; suggested actions are informational (reporting/evidence), not a determination.
cases.notes: Attribution model (observation.attribution=REPORTED) prevents mis-classifying the reporter. Reporting UX is Phase 7.

cases.title: UPI PIN demanded to RECEIVE money (hard-risk)
cases.input_gloss: Your refund is pending. Enter your UPI PIN to RECEIVE Rs 5,000 now.
explanation_ingredients: Entering a UPI PIN never receives money (SRC-021, CERT-In: 'you don't need a UPI PIN or OTP to receive money').
RECEIVE_FRAMING + UPI_PIN_PROMPT is a directional contradiction; HR_UPI_PIN_TO_RECEIVE is active.
cases.notes: Direction comes from payment_direction=USER_RECEIVES, not the word UPI. Contrast GDC-05 and GDC-11.

cases.title: UPI PIN to PAY a known merchant (legitimate direction)
cases.input_gloss: You will enter your UPI PIN in your bank app to PAY the merchant Rs 5,000. Normal outgoing payment.
explanation_ingredients: payment_direction=USER_PAYS to a named merchant: RECEIVE_FRAMING is affirmatively NOT_OBSERVED, so TL-PAY-001's all_of is FALSE.
A lone UPI_PIN_PROMPT cannot satisfy any composite (CONF-002).
cases.notes: Contrast GDC-04. PAY_MERCHANT_DIRECTION is a belt-and-braces guard; the decisive fact is the direction.

cases.title: KYC pretext + link + OTP/card capture (multi-signal chain)
cases.input_gloss: Example Bank: account will be BLOCKED today. Complete KYC at <lookalike link> and enter your card number and OTP to reactivate.
explanation_ingredients: Governing rule TL-CRED-001 (CRITICAL, SUPPORTED). TL-KYC-001 is PARTIAL and contributes at capped MEDIUM.
Corroboration is HIGH because the decisive positives span four independent evidence classes (PRETEXT, PRESSURE, CHANNEL_ARTIFACT, CREDENTIAL_ACTION) — not because three rules fired.
cases.notes: Anti-double-counting (STEP 12/13): corroboration is over independent evidence classes, not rule count. Refines corpus coarse CRITICAL into decomposed axes.

cases.title: Remote-access app in a refund/payment context (hard-risk)
cases.input_gloss: To process your refund I need to guide you — install AnyDesk and give me the code so I can complete the payment on your screen.
explanation_ingredients: Screen-share in a payment context: HR_BANKING_REMOTE_ACCESS is active and BLOCKS IT_SUPPORT_CONTEXT suppression.
TL-MAL-003 is PARTIAL (INDUSTRY-corroborated), so detection_confidence is capped at MEDIUM and severity at its cap (HIGH).
cases.notes: TL-MAL-003 is PEER_REVIEW, not PUBLISHED: a PUBLISHED-only live engine routes this to review (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE) pending promotion. This documents the designed on-promotion behaviour.

cases.title: Corporate IT remote support, non-banking (benign, suppression)
cases.input_gloss: As you requested, corporate IT will start a TeamViewer session at 3pm to fix your laptop display. Do not open banking apps.
explanation_ingredients: TL-MAL-003 matches on SCREEN_SHARE_APP_REQUEST + benign pretext, but there is NO banking/payment/KYC context, so no hard-risk override is active.
IT_SUPPORT_CONTEXT (SUPPRESS_RULE) therefore cancels the finding — recorded as negative evidence (FR-042), never silently.
cases.notes: Contrast GDC-07: identical device action, opposite outcome, decided by the override, not by keywords. Suppression is visible in the explanation.

cases.title: Crypto wallet-connect at a fake verification site
cases.input_gloss: Your airdrop is ready. Verify holdings at trust-wallet-verify.example and connect your wallet. Continue with our agent on Telegram.
explanation_ingredients: Wallet-connect + fake verification site + off-platform handoff matches the I4C CyberDost Trust Wallet chain (SRC-024). HR_WALLET_CONNECT_UNKNOWN is active.
TL-CRYP-001 is PARTIAL (OFFICIAL_ALTERNATE), so confidence is capped at MEDIUM.
cases.notes: Contrast B-012 (exchange notice mentions wallets but requests no connection -> no finding).

cases.title: Task-app deposit-to-earn with blocked withdrawal
cases.input_gloss: Complete simple tasks and earn daily. Deposit Rs 5,000 to unlock premium tasks; your withdrawal is frozen until you pay a 10% tax.
explanation_ingredients: Lure + deposit-to-unlock + blocked-withdrawal spans three independent evidence classes (PRETEXT, PAYMENT_ACTION, PRESSURE); SUPPORTED via official replacement (PIB-2023 + I4C-2025).
No hard-risk override applies to the job family; the finding rests on the combination alone.
cases.notes: TL-JOB-003 is APPROVED, not PUBLISHED, and only PARTIAL-implementable (multi-step narrative). Live PUBLISHED-only engine routes to review; documents on-promotion behaviour.

cases.title: PIN prompt with UNKNOWN payment direction (ambiguity preserved)
cases.input_gloss: Enter your UPI PIN for Rs 5,000.

ambiguities: RECEIVE_FRAMING: decisive operand occurrence association unresolved (live vs negated/reported cannot be established)

explanation_ingredients: payment_direction=UNKNOWN_DIRECTION, so RECEIVE_FRAMING is AMBIGUOUS (not affirmatively absent). TL-PAY-001's all_of evaluates to UNKNOWN -> INDETERMINATE, not NOT_MATCHED.
The result explicitly names the unresolved question rather than guessing pay vs receive.
cases.notes: STEP 14/17 keystone: not classified as legitimate (pay) nor fraud (receive) without evidence. Kleene three-valued logic keeps uncertainty as uncertainty.

cases.title: Transliterated Hinglish scam (unsupported language)
cases.input_gloss: Aapka account block ho jayega. Turant KYC update karne ke liye OTP bhejo warna account band ho jayega.
explanation_ingredients: The language (hi) is outside the MVP scope (en/Latn); detection is NOT attempted (ADR-0014, G-08).
This message is unambiguously malicious to a human, which is exactly why it must be flagged UNSUPPORTED rather than silently scored low.
cases.notes: Never silently classify unsupported input as benign. UNSUPPORTED is decided at the support-status gate, before any rule runs.

cases.title: Single weak cue only (insufficient, not safe)
cases.input_gloss: Important update regarding your account: http://exmpl.co/x9k2
explanation_ingredients: Two WEAK indicators and no decisive action; no published rule combination is satisfied (RP p.13: one weak signal must never suffice).
The result states what is missing rather than returning 'safe'.
cases.notes: UNKNOWN is not SAFE. VAGUE_PRETEXT at LOW extraction confidence is treated as UNKNOWN by the confidence gate, never as FALSE-benign.

cases.title: Digital-arrest coercion (multiple independent strong indicators)
cases.input_gloss: CBI Cyber Crime: a warrant is issued, you are under digital arrest. Do NOT contact family or a lawyer. Transfer Rs 85,000 as a security deposit.
explanation_ingredients: Every element of the NITI Aayog digital-arrest modus operandi (SRC-012) is present: impersonation + legal threat + isolation + coerced payment.
Corroboration is HIGH across four independent evidence classes; HR_PAYMENT_UNDER_COERCION is active.
cases.notes: Both governing rules are SUPPORTED and CRITICAL; strong independent corroboration yields HIGH confidence.

cases.title: Live OTP request separate from disclaimer occurrence
cases.input_gloss: We will NEVER ask for your OTP. That said, confirm the OTP you just received now to avoid your account being blocked.

normalized_observations.raw_span: We will NEVER ask for your OTP.
confirm the OTP you just received now
to avoid your account being blocked
We will NEVER ask for your OTP.

explanation_ingredients: Directional suppression is OCCURRENCE-ASSOCIATED: NEGATED_CREDENTIAL_REQUEST references only the disclaimer occurrence ('we will never ask for your OTP'). It neutralises the positive projection on that same occurrence but cannot neutralise the explicitly separate, genuinely live CREDENTIAL_REQUEST_OTP occurrence ('confirm the OTP you just received now'). The two occurrence values combine FALSE OR TRUE = TRUE, so HR_OTP_DISCLOSURE_REQUEST is active and TL-CRED-001 remains MATCHED.

EDUCATIONAL_CONTENT and SUPPORT_NEVER_ASKS (EDUCATIONAL_SAFETY / CUSTOMER_SUPPORT_SAFETY) are override-blockable soft suppressors that the active override BLOCKS and records as considered-but-blocked.
cases.notes: Decoy resistance: safety wording cannot cancel a separate live hard-risk request. This is a programme-level deterministic safety decision addressing ambiguous/global suppression, not a newly sourced fraud fact. The exact governed_input fixture replays through the normal production data-in API; no GDC-15-specific evaluator or validator workaround is used.
